items.title: Standing-obligation admission
items.rule: Before planning or editing a Forge development cycle, load the public standing-obligation registry and any explicitly supplied external overlay, create a local cycle disposition, resolve every item, and pass the standing-obligation check.

items.title: Deferred state is not authority
items.rule: A deferred item, trigger, candidate, or prior observation never authorizes implementation, publication, merge, approval, or another consequential act. The controlling authority boundary still applies.

items.title: External overlay confidentiality
items.rule: An explicitly supplied external overlay is read-only development input. Do not discover, copy, quote, summarize, log, commit, or turn its contents into public Forge evidence. Persist only the opaque item identifiers needed for the gitignored local cycle disposition.

items.title: Existing authority boundaries are preserved
items.rule: Standing-obligation admission is procedural governance. It cannot weaken or replace deterministic Forge or Nornyx checks, evidence requirements, independent-review boundaries, or explicit human or organizational authority.
